60% all parameters and 30% critical rate (Light, Dark), 0-100% Atk relative to remaining HP, 200% critical damage & adds HP absorption to attack

dictionary.lore:
A device brimming with elemental charge. Flashes of light and darkness cross its scowling eyes.
Experimental technologies such as these gizmos are given to outstanding warriors of skill to test their effectiveness on the field. While rather satisfying for the testers, the same cannot be said of their unfortunate targets.
